```{python}
df = pd.read_json("https://github.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/raw/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json")
```

```{python}
# Prepare the data once for consistent downstream calculations
clean_df = df.copy()
clean_df["airport_name"] = clean_df["airport_name"].replace("", pd.NA)
clean_df["airport_name"] = clean_df.groupby("airport_code")["airport_name"].transform(lambda s: s.ffill().bfill())

numeric_columns = [
    "num_of_flights_total",
    "num_of_delays_carrier",
    "num_of_delays_late_aircraft",
    "num_of_delays_nas",
    "num_of_delays_security",
    "num_of_delays_weather",
    "num_of_delays_total",
    "minutes_delayed_carrier",
    "minutes_delayed_late_aircraft",
    "minutes_delayed_nas",
    "minutes_delayed_security",
    "minutes_delayed_weather",
    "minutes_delayed_total",
]
clean_df[numeric_columns] = clean_df[numeric_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

month_order = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"]
clean_df["month"] = clean_df["month"].replace({"Febuary": "February", "n/a": pd.NA})
clean_df = clean_df[clean_df["month"].notna()].copy()
clean_df["month"] = pd.Categorical(clean_df["month"], categories=month_order, ordered=True)
clean_df.head()
```

## QUESTION 1

__What is the best month to fly if you want to avoid delays of any length?__ Describe the metric you chose and why you chose it to calculate your answer. Include one chart to help support your answer, with the x-axis ordered by month.

September is the safest bet for on-time travel. Across all airports it shows the lowest share of delayed flights (16.5%), which means nearly five out of six flights depart without any delay at all. October and April are the next-best options, while December and June have the highest delay rates, so avoiding peak holiday and early-summer schedules matters.

```{python}
month_summary = (
    clean_df.groupby("month", observed=True)
    .agg(
        total_flights=("num_of_flights_total", "sum"),
        delayed_flights=("num_of_delays_total", "sum"),
        total_delay_minutes=("minutes_delayed_total", "sum"),
    )
    .assign(
        delay_rate=lambda d: d["delayed_flights"] / d["total_flights"],
        avg_delay_minutes=lambda d: d["total_delay_minutes"] / d["delayed_flights"],
        delay_rate_pct=lambda d: d["delayed_flights"] / d["total_flights"] * 100,
    )
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values("month")
)

month_summary.style.format(
    {
        "total_flights": "{:,.0f}",
        "delayed_flights": "{:,.0f}",
        "delay_rate": "{:.1%}",
        "avg_delay_minutes": "{:.1f}",
    }
)
```

```{python}
ggplot(month_summary) + geom_bar(
    aes(x="month", y="delay_rate_pct"),
    stat="identity",
    fill="#1f77b4",
) + labs(
    x="Month",
    y="Percent of flights with a delay",
    title="Monthly delay rate across all tracked airports",
) + theme(axis_text_x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))
```
